relationships.subject: Lmx1b+ dI5 interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: At both E11.5 and E12.5, Sncg expression colocalized with Lmx1b+, but not Pax2+, cells

relationships.subject: BMP7
relationships.evidence_quote: BMP7 depletion was shown to reduce the number of dI1, dI3 and dI5s in mouse

key_findings: Pseudotime analysis of an mESC-derived dorsal interneuron scRNA-Seq atlas identified transition-state genes (e.g. Gsg1l, Cbfa2t2, Tfap2b, Smoc1) validated by in situ hybridization in embryonic mouse spinal cord.
Sncg marks a terminal dI5 (Lmx1b+) population, and dI lineages become transcriptionally more homogeneous during terminal differentiation.
